analysis.rationale: JPEG: block_boundary=1.3257 (0%-FP signal), dct_zero_ratio target 0.5587 vs speckle:2+jpeg:1 sim 0.561, strongest available quality is severity 1 (peeled residual minimum 20.4; jpeg:3 bb diff 11% overshoot). Noise: multiplicative signature (residual_intensity_corr 0.4867 vs ~0 for additive gaussian/YCrCb; clipped_fraction 0.0205 vs speckle:2 0.0208; variance_ratio 0.843 vs 0.883; mean_shift -6.9 vs -4.9) -> noise_speckle severity 2, sev1 too weak (sigma diff 40%), sev3 overshoots (sigma 40%, bb 11%). §B IMPULSE is documented extreme_pct FP (signed-residual counting artifact). Blur absent (spectral_slope_ratio 0.995, FFT anisotropy 0, gm_ratio>1, peel worsens with blur). Global absent (no x_distortion function range matches variance_ratio 0.843 / mean_shift -6.9; clipping of speckle explains both). Support: pairs 1-2 MATCH, pairs 3-4 PARTIAL (bb 11% / sigma 25%), none WEAK/MISMATCH. Overall UNCERTAIN because noise MATCH can never be LIKELY and deterministic PSNR>=40 is unavailable under sigma>=2.
